acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Serpents family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Spitting Cobra, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Venom-Lane Specialist archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Upright forebody, broad patterned hood, compact rear coil, and visibly distinct paired venom glands.
Signature mechanic: Two-Fang Fan: each fang projects one narrow venom line, leaving a deliberate central or outer gap for the follow-up strike.
battlefieldDuty: Paint two visible venom lanes and threaten a conventional strike through the remaining gap.
constructionDimensions: Glossy wet scales, translucent pressure membranes, coherent venom-water channels, and streaming body edges preserve segmentation.
Ripples trace body tension and attack lanes while drainage reveals the anchor or extended neck.
counterplay: Close behind the hood or bait both spits away from the escape route before crossing. Affinity signal: The loaded throat sac, anchor scute, or crown channel drains after release and exposes the same physical weak point.
forbiddenTreatments: Opaque water that conceals coil boundaries or fangs
identityInvariants: Every form remains limbless with a continuous scaled body, snake skull, jaw hinge, belly scutes, forked tongue, and species-appropriate tail.
Tier escalation uses body proportion, hood, fangs, horns, crown scales, muscle distribution, and coil behavior rather than arms or equipment.
Strike range, head anchor, venom direction, emergence point, and loosened coil remain visually traceable.
telegraph: Hood spots align with the two lanes and venom gathers separately at both fangs.
